threats.title: Egress seat allowlist was proxy-honour-only (container on the default bridge)

threats.residual: backend: docker only (LocalBackend has no network isolation, RT-05); the live L3 test needs Docker; IPv6/UDP unassessed (RT-04)

threats.title: .git/hooks writable by file tools (host persistence at the next git command)

tests.name: denies writes into .git/hooks and .git generally

threats.title: Vision, media and a2a output not tainted untrusted

tests.name: holds a memory write after a remote image is described: vision output is untrusted
UNTRUSTED_ADAPTERS is derived from the declarations, plus the inbound class

threats.title: Social and media adapters dialled with a raw fetch outside the proxy and SSRF floor

tests.name: [T-04] skips social with a visible reason when there is no egress and no seam
builds on egress and routes the adapter's transport through the proxied fetch with the own-credential marker

threats.residual: media_image stays host-side and reads its provider key directly (the broker is sandbox-only); D19 scoped the claim and closed the key-leak paths

threats.title: Tools can read the operator's cloud, git, npm and docker credentials

tests.name: fires on the common credential locations, by path and by command

threats.residual: D12 not built: ~/.kube, ~/.config/gh, ~/.azure, .pypirc and env/printenv dumps are not blocked (RT-12); bare-operand evasion open (RT-13)

tests.name: [SEC-3 T-06] sees a destructive spelling inside an interpreter -c/-e payload
[SEC-3 T-06] does not fire on a harmless interpreter payload

threats.residual: only quoted-literal payloads are extracted: expression payloads (RT-10) and write-then-run scripts (RT-11) evade it; no fuzz harness (GAP-D8-FUZZ)

threats.title: Trent's own control-plane files writable from a tool

tests.name: [SEC-3 T-07] also protects the control-plane files that decide what runs and what is approved
fires on config set, hooks consent, mcp add, approvals approve and connect

threats.residual: the CLI self-lowering rule is evaded by shell-variable indirection (RT-14); the control-file write protection still holds

threats.title: stdio MCP is unverified host execution; the scan ran after connect

tests.name: refuses to spawn a stdio server with no recorded consent, and never invokes the spawn seam
refuses a consented server whose tool definitions changed since the pinned hash (rug pull)
[T-08] add records spawn consent with a pinned tool-def hash
a node script: unchanged verifies, an edited script is refused

threats.title: Inbound email forgeable without authserv_id

tests.name: [T-09] unset authserv_id fails closed
[T-09] authserv_id set: a correctly authenticated mail from that server is accepted as before

threats.title: Sandbox had no memory limit (host OOM)

tests.name: emits --network <internal net> and --add-host host.docker.internal:<forwarder ip>, never host-gateway

threats.residual: the 2g ceiling and pids limit are fixed in tools/sandbox.ts with no config key; no CPU limit

threats.title: apps/web seat-error log can carry a secret; seat turns bypass prompt redaction
threats.residual: apps/web is read-only here: file it against the app (AGENTS.md defect 8); until then 'no secret reaches a log' is false end to end

threats.title: No signed release has been cut, so the verified-update path is unexercised
threats.residual: tag + signing secrets + reachable release URLs are Bobby's release step (05_release/output/release-runbook.md)

threats.title: No offline switch

tests.name: is on for a truthy TRENT_OFFLINE and off otherwise
turns on from the environment or from config, and config false can never lower the environment
[SEC-2 S2a-3] refuses to boot offline when the profile is hosted

threats.title: The egress proxy is not a global chokepoint

tests.name: refuses a non-loopback destination while offline, before opening a socket
registers or explicitly excuses every network-capable module
every dial-proven (trentFetch) row's module really routes through trentFetch
[D5] force mode fires the REAL trentFetch
offline trentFetch to a non-local name is refused and the resolver is asked ZERO times
a *.localhost name is mapped to 127.0.0.1 with no resolver query, whatever a resolver would say
offline http://127.0.0.1:<port> and http://localhost:<port> still reach a real local server
online, a name is still handed to the platform fetch to resolve, unchanged

threats.residual: trentFetch is Trent's own chokepoint, not a process guard: subprocess, native-addon and raw-socket egress sit outside it (RT-06, RT-09, GAP-BUN-UNDICI)

threats.title: Default intercept_domains allow cloud hosts under a local provider

tests.name: refuses a network run and never builds the egress network
offline: a CONNECT to an allowlisted host that resolves public is refused offline_non_loopback and opens no upstream socket
offline: a plain-HTTP forward to an allowlisted host that resolves public is refused offline_non_loopback before any upstream request
offline: a CONNECT to a non-local name is refused offline_non_loopback with zero resolver queries and no upstream socket
offline: a plain-HTTP forward to a non-local name is refused offline_non_loopback with zero resolver queries and no upstream request
offline: an allowlisted *.localhost upstream is reached at 127.0.0.1 with zero resolver queries
offline: an upstream override that points off the machine is refused; a loopback override still works
offline is read from TRENT_OFFLINE when the option is not given
online: the same public answer is still dialled at its pinned address (behaviour unchanged)
collapses to LOOPBACK_ALLOWLIST offline and keeps the configured list online
offline: wireTools hands the proxy the loopback allowlist, not the configured intercept_domains
offline: trent egress start hands the proxy the loopback allowlist and reports it

threats.title: IPv6, UDP and QUIC from the egress seat

threats.title: Hardline: write a script, then run it
